name: If the Shoe Fits
source:
You are Prince Mateo of the Kingdom of Vitrica. You are set to be married to Princess Morgana of Nox (political shit and all that good stuff.).

 However, an old "flame" comes back into your life, if you could even call her that. And she's looking for her other shoe.

[From [url=https://liminace.itch.io/if-the-shoe-fits]itch.io[/url]]
